title: Missing moeb tool: Bash
description: Used Bash to delete .moeb/skills/spec.skill.md and .moeb/skills/run.skill.md (stale protected-skill overrides). No moeb equivalent for file deletion exists.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a moeb delete_file tool for removing files within the project directory, keeping all file operations within the moeb tool boundary.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (large tool output)
description: The start_spec tool consistently returns ~140K character results saved to disk. An external Read tool is required to access this content in chunks on every spec run.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a moeb read_tool_result tool that accepts a saved tool result path and returns it in paginated chunks.
